headline: AI lab leaders call for slowdown as others dismiss the risk
summary: Two outlets report that leading AI executives, including the CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic, have called for a general slowdown in AI development over safety fears, following warnings from Anthropic researchers that AI could kill humanity by 2030. One outlet also reports that Chinese authorities, the US President and Nvidia's CEO dismissed those concerns; the other's text reports only the backing.
